name: [UPD] CHAMBERED
desc:
Welcome to CHAMBERED. Use a diverse arsenal of weapons to battle your rivals in this free-for-all arena style game where every shot counts!

🎯 One shot enemies at any range
💀 Head shot enemies for more cash
🔫 Unlock new skins for your guns and knives
🏆 Climb the ranks by getting more kills

Inspired by: One in the Chamber, One Shot and Flick
